subject: general
question: Which historical figure was honoured with a commemorative postage stamp released by Vice President Shri C.P. Radhakrishnan in December 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Emperor Perumbidugu Mutharaiyar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Vice President Shri C.P. Radhakrishnan released a commemorative postage stamp in honour of Tamil Emperor Perumbidugu Mutharaiyar II (Suvarana Maran) at Upa-Rashtrapati Bhavan, New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Emperor Perumbidugu Mutharaiyar belonged to the Mutharaiyar dynasty, which ruled central Tamil Nadu from the 7th to the 9th centuries CE.**
 
• He ruled from Tiruchirapalli for nearly four decades, known for administrative stability, territorial expansion, cultural preservation, and military prowess.
 
• Inscriptions across Tamil Nadu highlight his contributions to temples, irrigation schemes, and Tamil literature.
 
• The release is part of the Government of India's efforts to honour Tamil culture, heritage, and unsung rulers under the leadership of PM Narendra Modi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Mutharaiyar Dynasty**__

 __
 
• Central Tamil Nadu rulers from 7th–9th centuries CE.
 
• Known for contributions to administration, culture, and infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Stamp**__
 __
 
• Recognises the historical and cultural contributions of unsung Tamil rulers.
 
• Part of broader government initiatives like Kashi Tamil Sangamam and Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav to honour regional heritage.
 
 
 
• **Preservation Efforts**__
 __
 
• Since 2014, approximately 642 stolen statues and ancient artifacts, many from Tamil Nadu, have been recovered and secured.
 
• Highlights the national priority of documenting and preserving cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **Other Dignitaries Present**__
 
 
• Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha Harivansh, and Minister of State L. Murugan attended the event.
